svg.title: What WarHeatMap does
svg.desc: Four panels. The map: heatmap and markers together, filterable by country, tag and severity, with every filtered view shareable as a link. One page per event: a permanent URL with date, place, severity and source. Sourced, not scraped: an approved-outlet registry gates what gets on the map. The desks: significant events are posted to Bluesky autonomously, each linking back to the map.
